synodal pathway update: national synodal assembly saturday, 17 october , was a momentous and historic day in the life of the irish church in which over a dozen delegates from our diocese participated.
locally in our parishes there is much to receive from the prayer, listening and discernment of the past five years.
the working document for the assembly is still a valuable document for parishes and a number of accounts and reports from the day can be viewed in the latest news section of
these are important to read alongside the raw figures on each proposal.
our delegates will gather with bishop denis on 3 november to reflect on the assembly and where it is leads us now.
